scope: Uphold the exact conservative partial factual record, including five original units, terminated cutoff states, and the formal 1982-08-17 revocation event. This verdict does not adopt all producer explanations as categorical legal prerequisites for a complete claim. The necessity qualifications below are part of the review; no human/full-readiness certification is made.
rationale: The independently read complete original creates an indefinite council of eight federal officers, requires advice and coordination concerning a separately statutory Bank, and provides Treasury support. No sunset, actual-report trigger, executed repeal or separate future command appears. EO12379 section 15 expressly revokes the order, with no delayed effect or Council savings elsewhere in its complete text. The quoted 1982-08-17 formal event and all five terminated cutoff states are supported. The candidate conservatively leaves earliest ends and savings null; no fabricated date follows. The full held FACA statute excludes committees composed wholly of full-time federal officers or employees, so its generic two-year termination rule is not an affirmative earlier-end lead here. The actual HEW departmental succession may affect the precise membership wording but does not establish whole-Council cessation. The original itself distinguishes the Bank statute from this Council. Missing image bytes are transparently disclosed and do not alone undermine these unambiguous matched official EO extracts.

necessity_qualifications.assessment: The exclusion wording, read with the all-federal roster, resolves the proposed generic two-year sunset on the held substantive text. The statute archive is an LFS pointer and its single-document PDF fixity is not_listed, not mismatched. Those are custody limitations; they do not create legal uncertainty about the exclusion or evidence of a 1976 expiration. The producer phrase required official-fixity match is not adopted here as a universal rule that statutory legal scope is unresolvable.

Public Law 96-88 is a concrete pre-1982 office-succession lead for the membership wording. Its actual operative provisions were not located/read in this review, so no exact succession date or membership first-end allocation is certified. The possible change to an office reference is not itself a whole-order termination or a required reason to leave unrelated advice/support mandates undated.

EO11782 section 2 expressly identifies the Bank as established by Public Law 93-224. The Council revocation does not purport to revoke that statute. Reading the Bank Act would strengthen the source record for the independent basis, but generic continuing Bank functions are not shown to be residual commands of this EO. The review does not endorse a categorical need to prove the Bank ended before closing the Council lifecycle.

No images were inspected. Complete, unambiguous official EO extracts plus matching issue-PDF fixity support the limited findings; absence of images is not alone a substantive legal blocker under this assignment. The real USC coverage limit is 2026-10-09, but no affirmative revival or later contrary source was identified, and a general coverage limitation is not such evidence.

retained_material_gaps_as_written: STATUTORY_SCOPE_CUSTODY: the held full Public Law 92-463 extract contains the exclusion for committees composed wholly of full-time federal officers or employees and the two-year termination rule. Its opus archive is only a Git LFS pointer in this checkout and the cited PDF hash lacks an official-fixity MATCHED_BY_SHA256 entry. The all-federal membership strongly supports exclusion, but that statutory predicate is not promoted to authenticated source evidence.

MEMBERSHIP_SUCCESSION: original section 1 includes the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare. The Department of Education Organization Act, Public Law 96-88, is a concrete pre-1982 statutory lead for department redesignation and allocation/savings; its held original was not located. Whether this alters original membership wording without ending the continuing command must be checked before a complete first-end allocation.

FIRST_END_NOT_CLOSED: the only genuine located numbered-EO ending is EO 12379 section 15, effective August 17, 1982. The order itself has no sunset and inactivity alone does not end its legal authority. Nevertheless the identified statutory applicability and membership questions remain unclosed, so the formal cleanup date is recorded as a later event and is not automatically used for every first_end.

SAVINGS_AND_SEARCH: original section 2 identifies the Federal Financing Bank as separately established by Public Law 93-224. No explicit savings or independent future command appears in the complete original or revoker; the Act should be read to distinguish statutory Bank functions from this Council before closing residuals. The numbered-EO machine searches were read but are not sufficient for the identified statute questions, and the USC release stops at 2026-10-09.
unsupported_state_or_date_explanation: All first_end values remain null; the only dated legal event asserted is express formal revocation on 1982-08-17. The membership successor mechanics remain unadjudicated. The conservative blanks are accepted as partial omissions, not proof that their completion is legally impossible without every additional proposed source.
